description: Physical conservation laws and constraints for hypothesis validation. Operator-editable.

conservation_rules.label: Charge conservation
conservation_rules.description: Net charge must be zero for standalone compounds (or charge must be specified).

conservation_rules.label: Energy minimum principle
conservation_rules.description: Stable compounds form at local energy minima. Reaction energy should be negative (exothermic) or near zero for stabilization.

conservation_rules.label: Bandgap must be non-negative
conservation_rules.description: Photovoltaic absorber bandgap must be >= 0 eV.

conservation_rules.label: Biological dose window
conservation_rules.description: Drug/compound dose must be above minimum effective dose but below maximum tolerable dose.

unit_checks.label: Drug dose in mg/kg or μM

metadata.comment: Add domain-specific rules here. severity='hard' means hypothesis is rejected; 'soft' means warning is issued.
